messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: runtime-prod-usw2 - multiple pods in CrashLoopBackOff (SIGSEGV). 3 pods affected in runtime-engine-v1.8.2 deployment. Auto-retries hit 5x. Paging on-call. Logs attached below.

alex-cheung: acked. oncall switching to me. seeing crashloops on n[4-6].gpu-usw2. stacktrace points to custom kernel cublas wrapper.

mira-kato: on it. this is the v1.8.2 runtime we pushed yesterday with the new fused-kernel change, right?

sam-irving: yep. infra note: node gpu-12 shows oom_kill? but kernel sigsegv in runtime process before OOM. could be null-deref in custom kernel.

jordan-sre: quick customer-impact check: metrics show 4% of production requests failing 503s, latency spikes for the rest. error budget burn starting. notifying CS.

leo-support: flagged customers with high error rates: cust-omega and cust-apricot seeing retries. I'm drafting a status update.

alex-cheung: mitigation options: 1) scale down runtime-engine to 1 replica (reduce blast radius) 2) roll back to v1.8.1 image 3) cordon/evacuate suspect node 4) disable fused-kernel via env var. prefer quick rollback + node cordon. Thoughts?

mira-kato: agree rollback first. I can push v1.8.1 quick image roll. Disable fused-kernel is lower-risk if rollback takes time; set RUNTIME_FUSED_KERNEL=0.

sam-irving: cordoning node gpu-12 now: `kubectl cordon gpu-12.gpu-usw2.prod` and `kubectl drain gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` - pods will reschedule to other nodes.

alex-cheung: executing rollback: `kubectl set image deployment/runtime-engine runtime-engine=registry.redwood/re-runtime:1.8.1 --namespace=prod-usw2`

deploy-bot: Deploy started by mira-kato. Image: registry.redwood/re-runtime:1.8.1. CI: #build-4123.

mira-kato: patching deployment with env override while rollback in flight: `kubectl set env deployment/runtime-engine RUNTIME_FUSED_KERNEL=0 --namespace=prod-usw2`

alex-cheung: also setting `MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=1` for lower memory fragmentation: `kubectl set env deployment/runtime-engine MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=1 --namespace=prod-usw2`

jordan-sre: after rollback and cordon, monitoring. if crash rate doesn't drop within 2 minutes we will scale replicas to 0/1 and route traffic to fallback model variant (smaller) via smart-routing policy.

incident-bot: Update: rollback rollout at 40% (2/5 pods updated). Health checks passing on new pods.

leo-support: FYI CS update draft: "We're investigating runtime crashes affecting a subset of customers in us-west2; mitigation underway. We'll post updates every 15 minutes." Need sign-off?

anita-cs: go ahead and post. add note about potential degraded latency and 503s.

alex-cheung: logs from a failing pod before crash: ```
[2026-04-02T03:12:11Z] runtime-engine[pid:83] ERROR runtime/kernel.cpp:452 Null pointer deref in fused_gemm_kernel
[2026-04-02T03:12:11Z] runtime-engine[pid:83] SIGSEGV at 0x0
Backtrace:
  runtime::fused_gemm_kernel+0x1c2
  runtime::dispatch_kernel+0x48
  runtime::serve_request+0x3f1
```

mira-kato: that matches the fused-gemm path. v1.8.1 uses unfused fallback. hmm.

sam-irving: cordon/drain complete. gpu-12 is out of rotation. rescheduled pods to healthy nodes.

incident-bot: Rollout status: 100% v1.8.1 (5/5 pods). Health: 5/5 ready.

jordan-sre: initial indicators look good. crashloops stopped. error rate down from 4% to 0.5% over last 2 minutes.

leo-support: posted initial status to customers. received first replies from cust-omega asking for ETA.

anita-cs: sent targeted DM to cust-omega and cust-apricot with mitigation details and ETA ~30m while we finish verification.

mira-kato: root cause hypothesis: regression introduced by fused-kernel optimization in 1.8.2 causing null pointer in certain layer dims. will run reproducer on dev GPUs and open a PR to add null checks and unit test.

alex-cheung: follow-up actions: - open incident ticket and assign to mira-kato, - mark rollback as permanent until fix validated, - add automated canary integration for fused-kernel with small-batch test, - add a temporary op-level guard for fused kernels.

jordan-sre: I'll take postmortem and timeline. will collect heap/dump from the failed pods before they were drained (we saved one).

night-oncall: handoff note: I'm taking nightshift. if anything flares, alert me. I'll keep an eye on error budget dashboards. :eyes:

mira-kato: creating PR for fix and tests. linking to incident ticket INC-2026-144.

alex-cheung: thanks team. incident mitigated, customer impact reduced. keeping this thread open for postmortem docs and timeline. :thumbsup:
